name: Calipp
description: Calipp was a gas giant–type planet with twelve moons that was located in the Faarlsun system, a part of the Parthovian Cluster in Wild Space. The planet occupied the sixth and outermost orbit around its star, the yellow-white Faarlsun.
lead_paragraphs: Calipp was a gas giant–type planet with twelve moons that was located in the Faarlsun system, a part of the Parthovian Cluster in Wild Space. The planet occupied the sixth and outermost orbit around its star, the yellow-white Faarlsun.
